## What's new in 1.0.10

- **Fix:** clicking the desktop pet could fall through to whatever was behind it, when the pet had walked or appeared under a mouse that wasn't moving. If that was the "Live on my desktop" switch, the pet kept jumping between the desktop and the app. The pet now notices the mouse even when it's still.

## What's new in 1.0.9

- **Timer wheels:** set the timer with iPhone-style hours / minutes / seconds wheels, up to 23 h 59 min. New presets for 1 h, 1 h 30, 2 h and 3 h, and it shows when the timer will end.

## What's new in 1.0.8

- **Fix:** spaces and numbers can be typed in post-its and board notes again (they were being taken as keyboard shortcuts).

## What's new in 1.0.7

- **To-do tab:** a jamboard of post-it notes. Starts as a To do → Scheduled → In progress → Done pipeline, but the sections are yours to add, rename, move, resize and recolour. Drag notes between them, give them due dates (shown in the calendar and as a pet quest), and finishing one in a Done section earns your pet 5 coins.

## What's new in 1.0.6

- **Boards in Notes:** a free canvas for research. Paste or drop screenshots, links, PDFs and text anywhere; drag, resize and colour the cards.
- **Quests from your real work:** the next chapter of your nearest exam, or a Todoist task that is due, earns 30 coins.
- **Thought bubble:** your pet shows what it needs (🍖 😴 🧶). Click it to see how to help.
- **Your own pet:** turn any picture into a pixel pet. Plus a new **Frog** in the shop.
- **Todoist:** tasks with a due date show in the calendar; **Done** ticks them off in Todoist too (Settings → Accounts).

## New install

1. Download **Nightdesk-Setup-x.y.z.exe** below (under *Assets*).
2. Double-click it. If Windows shows **"Windows protected your PC"**, click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is not code-signed).
3. Click **Install**. NightDesk opens, and from then on it's on your desktop and in the Start menu.

## Already have NightDesk?

- **1.0.5 or newer:** nothing to do. It updates itself in the background and installs the update next time it closes (or click **Restart to update** when it says one is ready).
- **1.0.4 or older:** download the Setup below and run it **over** your current NightDesk. Don't uninstall first. All your data stays, and from then on updates come by themselves.

Your data lives on your laptop in `%USERPROFILE%\.nightdesk` (daily backups in `Documents\Nightdesk Backups`), outside the app folder, so installing, updating or even uninstalling never deletes it.

See the [README](https://github.com/Shoaib1M/NightDesk#readme) for features and optional Google Calendar / Spotify setup.
